events.content:
Fixed. The product page was awaiting `getInventory()` — which calls `connection()`, a runtime-only API — at the top level of the page component. That made the entire route dynamic, so clicking the link from home showed nothing until the server finished rendering the whole page. The change in `app/product/page.tsx`: the page component is now synchronous and renders the `

Premium Widget

` directly, while the inventory data moved into an async `` child wrapped in `` with a "Loading inventory..." fallback. The build output confirms it worked: `/product` now shows as `◐ (Partial Prerender)` — the title and fallback are prerendered as static HTML that appears immediately on navigation, and the stock count and price stream in when the server data resolves.
